semantic.justification: Original Calendar owner now has default/adopted/reference/copy constructor paths, base assignment, actual owned zone, root-initialized Locale metadata, platform UTC getNow, locale/week/weekend data, field/stamp/time cache and complete inherited UTC/field algorithms. Original constructor guard/clear/zone ordering is retained; LocalPointer(null,status) sets memory error before the explicit unreachable null-argument branch (CALC-342). Reference overloads use a transient tag so a clone callback that changes status still leaves the nonnull clone adopted as source. Calendar remains abstract for its actual virtual arithmetic/clone interface, not because construction is replaced by a placeholder. getLocale returns a Locale value, while LocaleBased supplies shared selector/ID semantics. Original zone adopt/set/orphan behavior including CALC-319 and existing CALC-310/311 time behavior remain unchanged. Unchanged ICU78.3 library witnesses pass 14994 locale/week cases over 993 requested names and 1440 constructor/copy/weekend cases. They observe all six week/weekend fields, valid/actual Locale values and literal root IDs, incoming error/warning behavior, default and keyword timezone selection, reference/adoption clone counts, null/error and aliased-status clone callbacks, all initialized field/stamp/flag and derived state, date-versus-clock initialization, completed UTC fields and weekend work clones. Existing 63050 scalar/calendar and 12929 time cases also pass after fixtures use real constructors and explicit public controlled baselines. Custom ICU service registration, remaining unconsumed APIs (including general add/roll and custom cutover mutation), full LibreOffice formatter/column/CSV integration, native allocation/OOM/destructor/ABI/undefined or uninitialized memory and platform fake-clock facilities remain uncertified. The actual shared-cache factory and all18 standard calendar classes are now ported separately; their bounded native witnesses do not imply complete ICU/UNO certification. B8TCAE adds portable actual-owner regression evidence from unchanged ICU78.3 compiled witnesses, retaining pinned source/archive/witness SHA256 values in native-observation fixtures. Public constructor/clone/field/time/limit and original protected-hook callers cover all18 calendar owners; actual RuleBasedTimeZone rule graphs include gap/fold enum options; EraRules uses genuine immutable resources; Calendar factory overloads use real cache/locale/timezone owners. Concrete native-derived cache clients verify reference counts, aliases, cached warnings/errors, eviction and destructor order. Only the host Date clock/default locale/timezone are controlled for reproducible native current-era observations; no core method, allocator, service or registry is replaced. This is bounded test evidence, not full native ABI/thread/allocator/whole-module parity. Runtime code and all broad semantic status fields remain unchanged; unresolved100 coverage gaps remain explicit.
